name: Fetch MCP Server
description: HTTP tool — fetch web pages and API responses (GET by default; optional method gated by allow_unsafe_methods; optional custom headers gated by allow_custom_headers with $env:/$secret: expansion)

config_schema.label: Allow Unsafe Methods
config_schema.description: When false (default), the fetch tool only allows safe/read-only HTTP methods (GET, HEAD, OPTIONS). When true, all HTTP methods (POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, etc.) are allowed. Configure per-plugin via the config endpoint (POST /api/plugins/tools/bundled/fetch/config with {"config":{"allow_unsafe_methods":"true"}}) or the plugins.yml `config:` map. The value reaches the plugin subprocess as the env var `allow_unsafe_methods`.

config_schema.label: Allow Custom Headers
config_schema.description: When false (default), the fetch tool REJECTS the optional `headers` argument with an informative error. When true, the agent may define custom HTTP headers per call (JSON object, header name -> string value). Header values support call-time reference expansion: `$env:VAR` (plugin environment) and `$secret:NAME` (omniagent secrets store), so credentials such as "Authorization": "Basic $secret:TWILIO_BASIC" never appear literally in the tool call. Header names/values containing CR or LF are rejected (header injection), as are values >8 KiB, more than 32 headers or >16 KiB in total; values expanded from `$secret:` are redacted from the tool result. Configure via plugins.yml `fetch.config.allow_custom_headers` or POST /api/plugins/tools/bundled/fetch/config with {"config":{"allow_custom_headers":"true"}}. The value reaches the plugin subprocess as the env var `allow_custom_headers`.

config_schema.label: Secrets Store Database URL
config_schema.description: Postgres URL of the omniagent secrets store, used ONLY to expand `$secret:NAME` references in fetch header values at call time (read-only SELECT on the secrets table; the value is never logged and never written anywhere). Default `$env:DATABASE_URL` resolves to the same database the omniagent server itself uses. Leave empty to disable `$secret:` expansion: a header value referencing $secret:NAME then fails with an explicit error naming the secret and this config key.
